articles.summary: ~Reports Fourth Quarter Revenue of $520.1 Million~ ~Growth From Higher-Margin Businesses Drives Gross Margin Expansion Despite Challenging Retail Environment~ ~Continued Inventory Reduction Strengthens Balance Sheet~ MarineMax, Inc. (NYSE: HZO) (“MarineMax” or the “Company”), a boat and yacht retailer, marina operator, and superyacht services company, today announced results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year ended September 30, 2026. Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter Summary Revenue of $520.1 million Same-store sales decreased 5.7% Gross margin increased 270 basis points to 37.4% Net loss attributable to MarineMax of $13.0 million Net loss per share of $0.59; adjusted net loss per share 1 of $0.08 Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $21.8 million Fiscal 2026 Full Year Summary Revenue of $2.2 billion Same-store sales decreased 5.5% Gross margin increased 240 basis points to 34.9% Net loss attributable to MarineMax of $8.2 million Net loss per share of $0.37; adjusted earnings per diluted
articles.title: MarineMax Reports Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results
